scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @okbot/shared build && pnpm --filter @okbot/agent build && pnpm --filter @okbot/desktop dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @okbot/shared build && pnpm --filter @okbot/agent build && pnpm --filter @okbot/desktop build
